name: Code Candy Auth Slanted Overlay
useWhen: A project needs a dark, premium auth surface where a slanted gradient overlay switches between sign-in and create-account forms only after the visitor clicks.
preferredStack: Motion for React when integrating into React
implementationNotes: Keep the overlay transition click-triggered and reversible.
Use real form controls, labels, validation, and secure backend auth in production.
Remove source-video headings and keep preview UI design-only.
Use transform, opacity, filter, and clip-path; avoid layout-shifting autoplay loops.
reducedMotion: Show the selected form instantly, remove blur/slide timing, and keep both forms reachable by keyboard.
avoid: placing code text inside the visual preview
